LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_MoyoBloodline.label: (Raven) Moyo Bloodline (Lesser)
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_MoyoBloodline.description:
A bloodline branch from the deep-sea Moyo. The bearer's blood is partially assimilated by a deep-blue substance, granting a slight toxin resistance and the ability to slowly produce deep-blue blood plasma.

Effects:
- Enables deep-blue blood plasma production
- Toxin resistance +10%
